import re

# Define a function to parse a note content
def parse_expenses(content):
    expenses = []
    # Each expense line starts with "- "
    for line in content.split('\n'):
        line = line.strip()
        if not line.startswith('- '):
            continue
        # Pattern: "- Payer paid $amount for "Description". Owed equally by Debtor1, Debtor2, ..."
        m = re.match(r'- (\w+) paid \$(\d+(?:\.\d+)?) for "([^"]+)"\. Owed equally by (.+)\.', line)
        if m:
            payer = m.group(1)
            amount = float(m.group(2))
            description = m.group(3)
            debtors_str = m.group(4)
            debtors = [d.strip() for d in debtors_str.split(',')]
            expenses.append({

                'description': description,
                'debtors': debtors

    return expenses
